title: SAVED BY GRACE
author: Fanny Crosby
stanzas: Some day the silver cord will break, And i no more as now shall sing; But O the joy when I shall awake within the palace of the King!
Some day my earthly house will fall I cannot tell how soon t'will be; But this I know - my all in All has now a place in heav'n for me.
Some day, - till the I'll watch and wait, My lamp all trimmed and burning bright, That when my Saviour opens the gate, My soul to Him msy take its flight.
And I shall see Him face to face, And tell the story- Saved by grace; and I shall see Him face to face, And tell the story- Saved by grace
